steps: Each week, active training clients receive an automated check-in form asking about sleep, energy, soreness, and how last week's workouts felt, and their responses feed directly into a training log the trainer reviews before programming the next week's sessions.
Completed workouts are logged via the client app, and any client who skips more than two workouts in a row triggers a personal outreach from the trainer.
The trainer spends their time coaching, not chasing clients for updates or manually tracking adherence in a notebook.
automations.manualProcess: Done by hand, this depends entirely on a personal trainer remembering to check in, update records, and follow up, with no safety net if something slips.

steps: When a class reaches capacity, additional sign-ups automatically land on the waitlist and receive a confirmation with their position.

The moment a registered student cancels, the next person on the waitlist is immediately texted with a booking link that expires in 30 minutes, keeping classes full without the studio owner or front desk manually managing the list throughout the day.
